Name: PC's Old World Furniture
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center][img=center]http://i.imgur.com/x8hqsof.png[/img]

A posh, if not old-fashioned, furniture pack to decorate your farmhouse. You know, if you're one of those fancy farmers who wishes to build a lavish cigar room in your farmhouse, this mod is definitely for you. This pack contains 52+ items, including antique double beds, elegant sofas, a magnificent fireplace, and many more!

This mod have built-in compatibility with [font=Roboto, sans-serif][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675/]Happy Home Designer[/url] a[/font]nd [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628/]Calcifer[/url]
If you have Calcifer mod installed, you can buy the furniture from their own dedicated catalogue sold by Robin for 250000g, or you can obtain them via vanilla furniture catalogue. Toggleable from Mod Option menu.


[img=right]http://i.imgur.com/J1JinJF.png[/img]

It’s finally here, everyone! I want to extend a huge thank you for all the support and encouragement I’ve received throughout the creation of this furniture pack (special thanks from my cats too!). I'm grateful for everyone's support and kind comments.[/center]


If you like this mod, don't forget to endorse! That way more people will see it and it'll give my modding spirit a boost. :D

Happy decorating!
